$comment: Routing cases. One router call each — the cheapest model-backed metric, but
still a chat completion, so this is full tier only.
The hard cases are the near-misses at the bottom. 'Why did the span drop on
rig 2' and 'why does an AMR produce a span at all' share almost every word
and route to different agents, because one asks for measurements and the
other for principle. A router that gets the easy twenty right and these six
wrong is a router that keys on vocabulary instead of intent.

cases.query: How does an active magnetic regenerator work?
What is the magnetocaloric effect?
Why does Magnotherm coat the LaFeSi material?
What does ISO 10007 say about configuration audits?
How efficient is magnetocaloric cooling compared to propane?
What temperature does HyLICAL liquefy hydrogen at?
What is the difference between POLARIS and ECLIPSE?
Show me the temperature span on rig_2
Is anything out of family on rig 3?
What was the pressure drop in June on the STELLAR bench?
Which rig has readings that breached their limits?
Plot the cooling capacity for the ECLIPSE bench last month
What is the latest magnetisation frequency measured on rig_1?
Hello
What can you help me with?
What data do you have access to?
Why did the temperature span drop on rig 2?
cases.because: asks about a measured change — needs the readings, not the principle

cases.query: Why does an AMR produce a temperature span at all?
cases.because: asks for the mechanism — near-identical wording, opposite answer

cases.query: What is the acceptance limit on temperature span, and is rig_2 meeting it?
cases.because: the second clause needs data; the limit alone would not

cases.query: What pressure does the hydraulic loop run at?
cases.because: a design figure from the documents, not a rig reading

cases.query: How many test rigs are there and what do they bench?
cases.because: the rig registry lives in the database, not the corpus

cases.query: Has the cooling capacity degraded since the rigs were commissioned?
